name: cond-auto-assess
page_section: conditions/auto-accident-injury :: The questions this examination is built to answer
scene: the patient sits on the edge of the treatment table, seen from behind and slightly to the side; the practitioner's two hands rest flat on either side of the patient's mid back and lower ribs, examining how they move
patient: a man in his thirties in a plain navy t-shirt
overlay_anatomy: the cervical and thoracic spine, the rib cage and the shoulder blades
pain_site_red_glow: the muscles of the lower neck and between the shoulder blades

name: cond-auto-treat
page_section: conditions/auto-accident-injury :: Settle the irritated tissue, then restore what stopped moving
scene: the patient lies face down on the treatment table; a white stand-mounted low-level laser head on an articulated arm, positioned a hand's width above the base of the neck and the upper back and projecting three thin red laser lines onto the skin without touching it; the practitioner's hand rests on the patient's shoulder blade
patient: a man in his thirties, lying face down, a light blanket over his legs
overlay_anatomy: the cervical and upper thoracic spine and the shoulder blades
pain_site_red_glow: the base of the neck and the top of the shoulders

name: cond-carpal-assess
page_section: conditions/carpal-tunnel :: We follow the nerve from the neck to the fingertip
scene: the patient sits on the treatment table holding one arm straight out to the side; the practitioner's fingertips trace along the inside of her upper arm, following the nerve
patient: a woman in her forties in a sleeveless top
overlay_anatomy: the median nerve running from the lower neck, under the collarbone, down the inner arm and through the wrist into the thumb and first fingers, with the arm bones faintly drawn
pain_site_red_glow: the carpal tunnel at the wrist

name: cond-carpal-treat
page_section: conditions/carpal-tunnel :: Free the tunnel, then unload the path into it
scene: a close view at table height: the patient's forearm and open hand rest palm-up on a folded white towel; the practitioner holds a small white handheld low-level laser probe held just above the crease of the wrist, casting a small red glow on the skin
patient: a woman in her forties; only her forearm and open hand are in frame
overlay_anatomy: the wrist and hand bones and the median nerve passing through the carpal tunnel
pain_site_red_glow: the carpal tunnel at the base of the palm

name: cond-fibro-assess
page_section: conditions/fibromyalgia :: One appointment that looks at the whole load
scene: the patient sits upright on the treatment table seen from behind; the practitioner's hands rest lightly on the tops of both shoulders, feeling the muscles
patient: a woman in her fifties in a soft oatmeal sweater
overlay_anatomy: the spine from neck to pelvis and the shoulder blades, with the major back muscles in fine lines
pain_site_red_glow: several small, scattered tender points: the base of the neck, the tops of the shoulders and beside the shoulder blades

name: cond-fibro-treat
page_section: conditions/fibromyalgia :: Low force first, and less of it than you expect
scene: the patient lies face down on the treatment table; the practitioner holds a small chrome spring-loaded adjusting instrument shaped like a thick pen with a flat rubber tip (no needle) gently against the muscles beside her mid spine, his other hand resting flat on her back
patient: a woman in her fifties, lying face down, a soft blanket over her legs
overlay_anatomy: the thoracic and lumbar spine with the muscles beside it
pain_site_red_glow: a few scattered tender points along the upper and mid back

name: cond-frozen-assess
page_section: conditions/frozen-shoulder :: We test what the arm is standing on
scene: the patient sits on the treatment table seen from behind and slightly to the side, slowly raising one arm forward; the practitioner's hand rests on her shoulder blade and his other hand lightly guides her elbow
patient: a woman in her sixties in a sleeveless sage top
overlay_anatomy: the shoulder joint, the shoulder blade, the collarbone and the upper arm bone

name: cond-frozen-treat
page_section: conditions/frozen-shoulder :: Give the capsule a reason to let go
scene: the patient lies on her back on the treatment table; the practitioner gently holds her arm at the elbow and the wrist and eases it out to the side in a slow, supported arc
patient: a woman in her sixties, lying on her back, head on a pillow
overlay_anatomy: the shoulder joint, the shoulder blade and the upper arm bone

name: cond-headache-assess
page_section: conditions/headache-migraine :: We look hardest at the days between the headaches
scene: the patient sits upright on the treatment table seen from behind and slightly to the side; the practitioner's fingertips rest at the base of her skull and on the jaw joint just in front of her ear
patient: a woman in her thirties with her hair tied up
overlay_anatomy: the skull base, the jaw joint and the upper neck vertebrae
pain_site_red_glow: the muscles at the base of the skull and the upper neck

name: cond-headache-treat
page_section: conditions/headache-migraine :: Work the neck, the jaw and the load behind them
scene: the patient sits upright on the treatment table seen from behind; the practitioner holds a small white handheld low-level laser probe held just above the base of her skull where the neck meets the head, casting a small red glow on the skin, his other hand steadying her shoulder
patient: a woman in her thirties with her hair tied up
overlay_anatomy: the skull base and the upper neck vertebrae
pain_site_red_glow: the muscles at the base of the skull

name: cond-lbp-assess
page_section: conditions/low-back-pain :: We test the whole chain, not only the sore part
scene: the patient lies on his back on the treatment table with one straight leg raised to about 30 degrees; the practitioner's flat hand presses gently down just above the ankle while his other hand steadies the opposite hip
patient: a man in his forties in a grey t-shirt and dark training trousers, lying on his back with his head on a pillow
overlay_anatomy: the lumbar spine, the pelvis and the hip joint of the raised leg
pain_site_red_glow: the lower back and the hip flexor where it attaches to the lumbar spine

name: cond-lbp-treat
page_section: conditions/low-back-pain :: Hands and instruments, in the same room
scene: the patient lies face down on the treatment table; a white stand-mounted low-level laser head on an articulated arm, positioned a hand's width above the lower back and projecting three thin red laser lines onto the skin without touching it; the practitioner's hand rests on the patient's upper back
patient: a man in his forties, lying face down, a light blanket over his legs, lower back bare
overlay_anatomy: the lumbar vertebrae, the sacrum and the pelvis
pain_site_red_glow: the two lowest lumbar vertebrae and the muscles beside them
